summary: Iter164 end-to-end verification. Backend: all 12 iter164 pytest cases PASS (webhook happy path + idempotency + bad/missing signature + 404 unknown token + case-bound event append; audit list scoping; template CRUD auth/dup/length/owner-scope/12-cap). Regression across iter150 + iter159 + iter163 = 57/57 PASS (record_invitation signature change did not break anything). Frontend: /professional/joint-alignment/bulk/history renders with 3 real bulk-history-row cards (data-testid=bulk-history-row-*), clicking a row loads detail pane with SA- case-id chips. pj-mine-bulk-history pill on /mine is an <a href> and navigates to bulk/history. pj-new-tpl-row/insert/save/manage all present on /new; save is properly disabled when textarea empty and enabled when filled; save opens inline TEMPLATE LABEL input; Manage modal opens with 'You haven't saved any templates yet' empty state and 12-template limit copy. Bulk page shows 'View past imports' link.

issues: LegalAcknowledgment modal (data-testid=legal-acknowledgment-modal, z-[1000]) re-mounts on every route change — even after the user acknowledges within the same session, next page navigation shows it again. Pre-seeding sac_legal_ack_v1 in localStorage does not persist it. This is pre-existing, out of iter164 scope, but is a UX friction and blocks automated test clicks unless the modal DOM node is removed. Consider persisting session-level flag or reading server-side ack on mount.

action_items: (Optional / P3, out-of-scope for iter164) Investigate why LegalAcknowledgment modal re-mounts on every route change in the same browser session even though STORAGE_KEY 'sac_legal_ack_v1' should suppress it. May be an unrelated legal_ack version bump or the modal component ignoring localStorage on fresh mount.
critical_code_review_comments: professional_directory.verify_webhook_signature correctly hashes raw request bytes BEFORE JSON parse, so tampered payloads with bad sig return 401 not 400 — good.
GET /api/professional/directory/invites response schema in joint_alignment_routes.py excludes invite_token — verified via test_invites_audit_list_is_scoped_to_caller; prevents token forgery.
Template hard cap of 12 is enforced server-side (13th → 409) — good defense-in-depth vs relying on FE.
ReminderNoteTemplatePicker exposes correct data-testids on both /new (pj-new-tpl-*) and /mine (pj-mine-tpl-{case_id}-*) surfaces — good for testability.
No mongo _id leakage observed in any iter164 endpoint response.
seed_data_creation: None — parent1 already had 3 existing bulk imports from prior iterations which were used to verify the row list + drill-down.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter164 is fully green. When automating this app, note the legal-acknowledgment-modal will intercept pointer events on route changes; remove it via `document.querySelector('[data-testid="legal-acknowledgment-modal"]').remove()` from page.evaluate before clicking pills/rows, or use JS .click() on anchor elements. Reminder textarea is data-testid='pj-reminder-note'. Template label placeholder is 'e.g. "Thursday intake"' (not containing the word 'label' as literal placeholder text — the visible 'TEMPLATE LABEL' is a <label> element, not the input placeholder).
